_comment: Attached to a real signed-in account with: npm run db:seed:demo -- you@iiitl.ac.in. The generated students cannot sign in, so without this the student portal looks empty when you browse it as yourself. Profile fields are only written where the account has none.

feedback.content: The Texas Instruments profile lists an 8.5 CGPA cutoff and mine is 8.9, but the eligibility panel took a while to update after I saved my academic details. Is there a refresh delay?
feedback.adminResponse: Eligibility recalculates on save. The panel you saw was a cached page; a reload shows the current result.
